entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Let's get this over with.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. Your sizing is a complete joke. It's the wrong size, it's way too tight and I can't even zip it up. I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear the jersey didn't fit as expected. I can definitely look into the options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
No, I don't have the order number! Are you kidding me? You think I keep that stuff lying around? Just look up my account! This is ridiculous, I want to speak to a manager!

I understand your frustration, and I can certainly try to locate the order without the number. I apologize for the inconvenience. Can you please spell out your full name and provide the email address used for the purchase?
Fine. It's Mark Peterson. M-A-R-K. Peterson, P-E-T-E-R-S-O-N. Email is markpete@fakemail.com. Now find it. I'm not waiting all day for you to figure this out.
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Series jersey, delivered on November 21st. That was about 51 days ago.

And? What's your point? Are you telling me I'm stuck with this thing that's too tight to wear? If you don't fix this right now, I'm going to light up your social media with reviews about your terrible products and even worse service. Get me your supervisor.

Not at all, sir. I was just confirming the details. Let me check our return policy for you... Yes, it looks like you're well within our 90-day return window for this item. I can absolutely process a return for a full refund, or if you'd prefer, I can set up an exchange for a different size.
Oh. Well, why didn't you just say that? Fine. An exchange then. I obviously need a larger size. Send me a Large.

Of course. I've just processed an exchange for the same jersey in a size Large. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just use that to send back the original jersey that was the wrong size. Your new item will ship out as soon as the carrier scans the return package.
Alright, fine. Just make sure you get it right this time.
We certainly will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
